Block n=1 holds only the plain-text cells of those four rows, copied in the text layer's own order (name, formula, oxidation state, physical appearance / chemical nature); the four 'common methods of preparation' cells are displayed reaction equations and are deferred to A2S separately as n=2 to n=5, because the text layer scrambles them below word level (e.g. '2NO / N O / 2N O / + / →').
